verdict.rationale: Lighthouse publishes nationality-restricted visa pages, including TN (USMCA, for Canadians and Mexicans) and E-3, plus an E-2 treaty-countries blog, which gives some origin-country-tied guidance. Consular interview support is listed only as a Plus-tier service, not as published guidance. Missing for 10: per-consulate processing guidance, country-specific backlog or visa-bulletin content (e.g., India/China EB queues), and dedicated pages for founders from specific countries.
